meta.title: DeepSeek media tools
meta.description: Agent tools for DeepSeek OCR, ASR and TTS.

settings.title: DeepSeek media tools
settings.intro: Configure the API key used by the deepseek_ocr, deepseek_asr and deepseek_tts agent tools.
settings.keyMissing: Not configured — the three tools stay hidden until a key is set
settings.saved: Key saved. The tools are available in new sessions immediately.
settings.privacy: The key is stored through the DSH credentials service and is never logged or returned by any tool.
settings.doc: Billing note: OCR is charged per page, ASR per second of audio, TTS per 10k billable characters (CJK counts double).
